keyVerseDR: "Rejoice with them that rejoice; weep with them that weep." (Rom 12:15)

level1.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Social Intelligence
level1.story: Social intelligence means noticing how others feel and choosing the right words and actions.
level1.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice social intelligence all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: When did we notice someone's feelings this week?
What words help someone who is sad or upset?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level1.prayer: Jesus, You saw every person's heart. Help me notice others and care for them. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Notice when someone looks sad
TUE: Ask, 'How are you feeling today?'
WED: Celebrate a friend's good news
THU: Use a gentle voice with someone upset
FRI: Wait your turn to talk
SAT: Thank someone and look them in the eye

level2.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Social Intelligence
level2.story: Social intelligence means noticing other people's feelings and knowing what to say and do. It helps us know when a friend needs a hug, a joke, quiet time, or help. Saint Paul says to rejoice with those who rejoice and weep with those who weep. Jesus always noticed people: the lonely, the sick, and the sad. We can learn to notice too.
level2.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice social intelligence all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: When did we notice someone's feelings this week?
How did God help us grow in social intelligence?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level2.prayer: Jesus, You saw every person's heart. Help me notice others and care for them. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Read someone's face and respond kindly
TUE: Comfort a friend who is having a hard day
WED: Choose kind words when you disagree
THU: Notice who needs a turn and give it
FRI: Help two friends make peace
SAT: Pray for someone you noticed was hurting
